business_analysis.name: Business Analysis
business_analysis.description: Comprehensive business analysis with strategic insights
business_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyze the following business data and provide:
                1. Key business insights and patterns
                2. Strategic opportunities and threats
                3. Actionable recommendations
                4. Market implications
                
                Data: {data}
business_analysis.expected_output_format: Structured analysis with numbered insights and recommendations

clinical_analysis.name: Clinical Analysis
clinical_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyze the following clinical data and provide:
                1. Clinical insights and patterns
                2. Evidence-based recommendations
                3. Patient safety considerations
                4. Quality improvement opportunities
                
                Data: {data}

trend_analysis.name: Trend Analysis
trend_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyze the following data for trends and provide:
                1. Emerging trends and patterns
                2. Trend significance and implications
                3. Future projections
                4. Strategic recommendations based on trends
                
                Data: {data}
trend_analysis.expected_output_format: Trend analysis with future projections and recommendations
